assignments.essential_function: Audit npm, PyPI and Go dependency metadata for version-matched advisories, abandoned upstreams, publisher concentration and install-script risk.

review: Read unchanged SKILL.md and README and statically inspected collector/parser/network boundaries, metadata and tests. Strong scoped dependency-risk workflow uses deterministic collection, exact-version advisory checking where a supported lockfile provides versions, explicit coverage, and distinct unavailable/clean/flagged states. The source already refuses unsupported ecosystems and failed collection rather than improvising. No edits or corrective wrappers proposed. Scripts and tests were not run; this is not a complete implementation audit.
native_prerequisites: Python >=3.11 and uv; bundled scripts are stdlib-only
Authenticated gh strongly recommended for GitHub rate limits; collector can return unassessable without it
Network to OSV, npm/PyPI registries, Go module proxy, deps.dev, OpenSSF Scorecard and GitHub
Optional pip-audit integration detected by source; no project/package installation by collector
Run documented uv commands from the skill package directory; Python >=3.11 is declared by the scripts’ inline PEP 723 metadata.

dependency_decisions: Excluded test_*.py, evals, fixtures, icon assets, agent UI metadata, pyproject.toml and uv.lock. Executed scripts use inline Python>=3.11 metadata and only import model.py/sources.py plus stdlib; test/lint manifests are not runtime inputs.
runtime_blockers: Requires an actual script execution environment, uv/Python3.11+, target manifests and network API access. Never replace script measurements with model estimates.
